evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract frames the value of reliable, fast return as a design good — capability of the system and stability of the agreement.
The appeal to no lost work is a security-and-stability value: preserving what was done against failure conditions.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Presenting two paths for obtaining the result frames self-origination — the caller chooses its own cadence and method.
